familyFormulas.module: Scored units are each imports/controllers/providers array entry. Expected relationships are distinct canonical from/kind/to plus required metadata; a supported source unit is unresolved if its relation is missing, node metadata is wrong, or required evidence is wrong. A dynamic entry is one unresolved source unit with no estimated runtime expansion.
familyFormulas.di: Scored units are constructor parameters of recognized module/controller/service/repository classes. Supported expected injects edges deduplicate identical from/to/semantics; source-unit unresolved counts parameter slots independently. Unsupported parameters are unresolved even with correct diagnostics.
familyFormulas.endpoint: Scored units are HTTP decorator-bearing handlers, one per decorator/handler. Each unit expects one Endpoint node with HTTP/path/handler metadata plus Controller exposes and Endpoint depends_on handler edges. Expected relation denominator deduplicates the two edge sets by canonical from/kind/to; one missing edge, bad metadata, or bad evidence makes the handler source unit unresolved.
familyFormulas.common: Correct/missing compare supported unique semantic edge keys. Wrong target produces one missing expected plus one false actual relation. Source location and evidence errors are recorded separately and fail overall technical verdict; they do not relabel a semantically correct edge false. False scope is source-owned Module composition, DI, Endpoint route, or call edge; imports and lexical Method contains stay outside it. No cross-family offset. Fractions compare exact numerator/denominator; zero denominator N/A.

rules.moduleSourceUnits: One entry in imports/controllers/providers arrays, including duplicate registrations; exports recorded but excluded from scored module source units. Dynamic expressions count once, with no runtime expansion.
rules.diSourceUnits: One constructor parameter of a module/controller/service/repository class; duplicates count separately for unresolved rate but supported expected edges are deduplicated for missing rate.
rules.endpointSourceUnits: One handler with one supported HTTP route decorator; separate handlers on the same path remain separate. No runtime route expansion.
rules.relationMatching: Canonical from/kind/to, semantic metadata, source location, evidence source/confidence. Missing true target and false other target count separately. No cross-family offset.
rules.unsupportedExplanation: Each unsupported source unit requires a scoped diagnostic with correct file, line, and related node. A single scoped diagnostic may explain multiple units only when mapping is explicit.
rules.zeroDenominator: N/A, never 100%. Unchecked items remain NOT_ASSESSABLE.

criteria.evaluation: Each of module, di, endpoint is judged separately. Never sum numerators or denominators across families.
criteria.falseFormula: Count actual source-owned family relations absent from the supported expected semantic edge set; unsupported-origin false relations count too.
criteria.supportedMissingFormula: For each family, missing supported unique semantic relation keys / all supported expected unique semantic relation keys. Keys are canonical from/kind/to plus required metadata; evidence defects are reported separately and fail overall technical verdict. Zero denominator is N/A.
criteria.unsupportedExplanationFormula: For each family, unsupported source units matched to a diagnostic with expected code, file, line and relatedNodeId / all unsupported source units. Zero denominator is N/A; silent omissions remain explicit.
criteria.majorStructureUnresolvedFormula: For each family separately: (unsupported source units + supported source units whose expected relation is absent or has wrong metadata/evidence, plus endpoint units with wrong/missing Endpoint node or metadata) / all scored source units in that family. Count each source unit once. Zero denominator is N/A.
criteria.callAndProvenanceFormula: Inventory: all 35 TS/TSX paths and SHA-256 must match the isolated clean input, no parse error; unverifiable input is NOT_ASSESSABLE. Declarations: all 36 class/interface nodes and all 59 named method nodes must match canonical ID, kind, name, source file/line, required evidence and display parent. Endpoint nodes additionally match HTTP/path/handler metadata and exposing Controller parent. Calls: exactly 141 source sites, seven direct supported sites and 134 scoped unknown sites; callAnalysis must equal 141/7/134 with scope=parsed_named_class_methods and mode=same_class_only. Seven supported sites require each canonical calls edge derived by deduplicating their from/kind/to tuples and every site line evidence; unique target count is a different quantity; any additional source-owned calls edge is false. Exactly one diagnostic per each of 76 expected method+reason groups must match code/file/minimum line/relatedNodeId/skippedCount; no extra group, duplicate, or wrong scope; total skippedCount=134. Any verified false call, missing target/site evidence, identity/metadata/evidence/parent mismatch, duplicate or wrong-scope diagnostic, counter/group mismatch, or canonical validator/CLI product failure is EXCEEDED. If input identity, Actual Graph, or required UI/Context observation cannot be established for an environmental reason, mark the affected check NOT_ASSESSABLE; do not report success. No fraction or cross-family pooling for calls/provenance.
criteria.verdictFormula: Per family EXCEEDED if false > 0, missing rate > 0.05, explanation rate < 1, or unresolved rate > 0.20; NOT_ASSESSABLE if relevant source units or supported edge denominator is zero without a failing measurable criterion, or any item remains undecided; otherwise WITHIN. Overall technical verdict EXCEEDED if any family or call/provenance condition exceeds, else NOT_ASSESSABLE if any family is N/A, else WITHIN. This is a provisional known-profile technical audit, not a release decision.
